namespace SandronesLibrary.NumberTheory.Algebraic.PrimeDecomposition
open NumberField Ideal
variable (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]

def IsRamifiedAt (p : Ideal ℤ) (P : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : Prop := P.LiesOver p ∧ P.ramificationIdx ℤ ≠ 1
def IsRamifiedIn (p : ℤ) : Prop := ¬ Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn (𝓞 K) (Ideal.span {p})

theorem sum_ramification_inertia_eq_finrank {p : Ideal ℤ} [p.IsMaximal] :
    ∑ q : p.primesOver (𝓞 K), q.1.ramificationIdx ℤ * q.1.inertiaDeg ℤ = Module.finrank ℚ K := by
  rw [Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia_eq_finrank p (𝓞 K), NumberField.RingOfIntegers.rank]

theorem isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_ramificationIdx_eq_one {p : Ideal ℤ} :
    Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn (𝓞 K) p ↔ ∀ P : Ideal (𝓞 K), P.IsPrime → P.LiesOver p → P.ramificationIdx ℤ = 1 := by
  rw [Algebra.isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_ramificationIdx_eq_one]

theorem dvd_discr_iff_isRamifiedIn {p : ℤ} (hp : Prime p) :
    p ∣ NumberField.discr K ↔ IsRamifiedIn K p := by
  rw [IsRamifiedIn, ← NumberField.not_dvd_discr_iff_isUnramifiedIn K (𝓞 K) hp]
  exact not_not.symm

theorem dvd_discr_iff_exists_ramificationIdx_ne_one {p : ℤ} (hp : Prime p) :
    p ∣ NumberField.discr K ↔ ∃ P : Ideal (𝓞 K), P.IsPrime ∧ P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {p}) ∧ P.ramificationIdx ℤ ≠ 1 := by
  rw [dvd_discr_iff_isRamifiedIn K hp, IsRamifiedIn, isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_ramificationIdx_eq_one]
  constructor
  · intro h; by_contra hc; push Not at hc; exact h fun P hP hL => hc P hP hL
  · rintro ⟨P, hP, hL, he⟩ h; exact he (h P hP hL)

noncomputable def kummerDedekind_primesOver_equiv_monicFactorsMod {θ : 𝓞 K} {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (hp : ¬ p ∣ RingOfIntegers.exponent θ) :
    ((Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).primesOver (𝓞 K)) ≃ RingOfIntegers.monicFactorsMod θ p :=
  NumberField.Ideal.primesOverSpanEquivMonicFactorsMod hp
